title: Challenges of Large Language Models for Mental Health Counseling

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review evaluating the dominance of English-language and 'anglosphere' sources in LLM training data, and discussing how this lack of cultural diversity limits contextual understanding for minorities, indigenous populations, and the developing world.

Literature review and conceptual discussion examining the limitations of current LLMs in recognizing and properly addressing the socioeconomic status of users within the context of mental health support.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual discussion highlighting the need for algorithmic fairness toward LGBTQ+ communities by reviewing literature on the unobserved characteristics, stigmatization, and specific mental health stressors these marginalized groups face.
